paragraphs: Rav Neḥemyah son of (Rav) Yosef, Shabbat 50b; Bekhorot 9b. Mar Zutra son of Rav Huna, son of Rav Pappi, said to Ravina, 'You teach this report of ר״י ב״י with reference to this?' [Chullin 48a names Rav Neḥemyah son of Rav Yosef. See there.]. The wife of Rav Yosef son of Rava came before him, Ketubbot 65a. He found Rav Pappi, Rav Pappa and Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua, Mo'ed Katan 19b. See below, R. Neḥemyah son of Rav Yehoshua: perhaps one is a scribal error; the Gemara is not now before me. Before Rava, Ein Tzadin 28a. He sent to Rabbah bar Rav Huna Zuta in Nehardea, Ketubbot 69a; Bava Batra 66b. See Rav Hamnuna son of Rav Yosef. Rav Dimi was his son.
